sectors.trend: Severely negative. Iron ore in active 'bloodletting' phase; cap raises signal balance-sheet stress. Gold underperforming ('schmould'). Small-cap miners (PolarX, Sunstone, Manuka) showing relative strength.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin compression. Canaccord-led cap raises dilute equity holders. Gold miners (NVS.AX, GSG.AX) lack safe-haven bid. Small-cap explorers offer speculative upside but high dilution risk.

sectors.trend: Mixed-to-negative. Mortgage wars return as lenders compete, compressing NIMs. ANZ.AX post-restructuring faces execution risk. Bank exits from truck financing signal credit tightening. Superannuation under political pressure.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX face margin pressure from rate competition. Credit cycle tightening in commercial lending. Super fund managers (HUB.AX, PPA.AX) face policy uncertainty.

sectors.trend: Positive for producers, negative for consumers. Oil 'explodes' as suppression fails. Santos preservation deal signals strategic value. Fuel prices rising 30c. Airlines (QAN.AX) squeezed by oil spike and staff shortages.
sectors.implications: SOL.AX, WDS.AX, XTL.AX benefit from oil surge. QAN.AX, DLP.AX face cost inflation. Santos deal (STO.AX) raises energy sovereignty debate.

sectors.trend: Negative. Housing prices crashing, auction market flat. First-home buyers surging but affordability strained. Tax burden rising. Private health insurance costs shifting to pensioners. Airlines pressured.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, WRE.AX) face occupancy and yield pressure. WES.AX, WOW.AX under consumer squeeze. IAG.AX, CGF.AX face health insurance policy risk.

sectors.trend: Healthcare: private health insurance cost-shifting to pensioners creates regulatory risk. Technology: AI leaders (Amodei, Altman, Musk) call for slowdown; AI capex question looms for global tech.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, WES.AX (pharma) relatively insulated but policy risk rising. ASX tech (W1.AX, XRO.AX) exposed to global AI sentiment shift.

Hedge AUD exposure; favour export-oriented miners and energy; avoid import-dependent consumer names
Underweight REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX); monitor RBA response; watch first-home buyer data

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX likely to extend $90bn weekly loss as oil-driven inflation fears and iron ore weakness persist. AUD weakness amplifies import costs. RBA caught between growth scare and inflation. Expect volatility around Fed meeting and BRICS outcomes. Key support for ^AXJO under pressure.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive if oil stabilises and iron ore finds floor. Housing correction may create entry points for REITs and construction. Energy transition (Santos, gas) offers structural tailwind. Superannuation reforms, if constructive, could boost fund manager valuations. AI slowdown narrative may redirect capex to Australian infrastructure.
